showcaseApi.liveness(mode): the L7 liveness probe: with mode ('auto' | 'observe' | 'off') switches it (observe = detect and record, never restart: hang hunts; also ?liveness=observe); returns status().liveness. Probes are textDocument/hover at 0:0 with string ids showcase-live-<n> and full params, each sent with a main-loop probe ($/showcase/liveness, string id showcase-main-<n>, params {}: an unknown method the FileWorker's main loop answers MethodNotFound at once, without a pool thread; liveness.mainLoop); a hover reply later than probeTimeoutMs is late by its elapsed time (never 'answered'); replies are swallowed in the relay.toClient tap; 2 unanswered (probeTimeoutMs each) after probeAfterMs of silence = wedged; auto restarts once per restartGapMs (relay.restart, notice 'Lean stopped responding and was restarted'), then the stall card is the fallback (UX suite C21, C22). On a QED64 page with its own liveness (status().liveness present: QED64 9fdf9b8+, HARDENING #52) the probe DEFERS to it: it starts only after probeDeferMs (30 s; ?probeDefer=<s>) without progress, never acts while QED64 reports a stall in its grace window (action 'deferred'), and QED64's own rescues, stalls and 'wedged' reboots are reported in liveness.qed64 and the qed64-* events (notice 'Lean stopped responding; QED64 is restarting it')
invariants: status().bridge.installs[*].qed64Present === false and status().bridge.late === 0 (installed before the page's module script; a late install lets the page's own listener run too)
status().stall.shown === 0 on a healthy run (no false stall alarm; W1-W8 and C20 assert it), thresholdMs 45000 by default (?stall=<s> overrides, >= 5)

status().liveness.wedged === 0 and restarts === 0 on a healthy run (no false liveness alarm; W1-W8, C20 and C22 assert it), probeAfterMs 10000 / probeTimeoutMs 5000 / restartGapMs 120000 by default (?probe, ?probeTimeout, ?restartGap override)

_scenarioNotes.bootFailure: tests that deliberately make the boot fail (C8 missing overlay, C9 unpaired overlay, C11 network cut, C12 unreachable overlay): the relay's own death path logs and throws 'QED64: the Lean checker died (bootFailed)' once per counted death (3 before the breaker), and a missing overlay file is a 404 resource error. Never allowed in any other test.
_scenarioNotes.networkCut: tests that cut the network on purpose (C11 CHAOS, C12 aborted routes): Chromium logs the aborted / truncated resource, and QED64's snapshot prefetcher warns that it falls back to streaming. Never allowed in any other test.
_scenarioNotes.exactImportsFallback: C16 only: after 'Load exact imports' QED64 compiles the header's import lines against the essential pack; when that fails it warns '[qed64] exact import failed: …; serving the header from the preloaded library' and keeps serving the covered header (resident-session.ts:209-224, the designed degradation C16 checks).
_scenarioNotes.qed64WedgedReboot: C23 (its forced-death fixture), and C20 and W1-W8 only when QED64 9fdf9b8+ itself declared a session wedged and rebooted it (an L7 occurrence handled upstream, status().liveness.qed64.wedgedReboots > 0): its relay answers every request in flight with 'QED64: the Lean checker died (wedged)' (lsp-relay.ts onDied -> failInFlight), which lean4monaco logs at the same site as stallRestart. Never allowed in any other test.
_scenarioNotes.livenessObserved: tests (or hang hunts, UX_LIVENESS=observe) in which the gallery's liveness probe, in OBSERVE mode, declares a frozen checker wedged: gallery.js logs one console.warn per wedge and restarts nothing (C21 (b); C20 and W1-W8 only when an observe-mode wedge was recorded). Never allowed in any other test.
_scenarioNotes.stallRestart: tests that answer a stalled checker (QED64 L7) with the gallery's Restart Lean / Reset (C21; C20 and W1-W8 only when a real stall was recovered): QED64's relay.restart() answers every request still in flight with the hard-coded error 'QED64: restarting with exact imports' (lsp-relay.ts:127 failInFlight; -32603, rpc calls -32900), which lean4monaco logs at its NotificationService site and leaves as an unhandled rejection. A stalled checker always has requests in flight (nothing was answered), so a restart of one produces these; a restart from ready (C16) has none. Never allowed in any other test.
